meta.title: 하루 세 칸
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (하루 세 칸, a three-task habit app (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 하루 세 칸, a three-task habit app (fictional)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: The brief asks for almost nothing: a near-white desk #F4F5F7, white cards, a dark blue-grey ink #1F2430 with #5A6170 and #646B78 for the quiet text, one blue #3B6EF5 for every action, and green #2BB673 only for done. The one exception is earned: an iridescent bloom when the day is complete.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable, as clean UIs set Korean: 800 for titles, 600 for rows, 500 for meta, tight tracking.
rationale.motion: Real use, not decoration: springs that settle without wobble, a macOS arrow that glides between targets with a small arc and clicks (a press and a ripple), checks that fill and tick, rows that strike through, a ring that steps; confetti and the bloom only at 3/3. Scenes dissolve.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 128 BPM in E major (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s), soft; glassy SFX: a click for every click, a confirm at 3/3, sparkles, a tick per dot of the week.
rationale.visuals: All code: cards with two layered shadows and a hairline, checks, a progress ring, a toggle, a week of 21 dots, the arrow cursor, the app icon, the bloom (a blurred conic gradient) and confetti.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a quiet product teaser that reads without sound.
